description:
Help a builder select a small, correct package set before showing the full catalog.

Exit criteria:
- A new user selects a recommended stack before entering the full catalog.
- Package roles and boundaries match current READMEs.
- Maturity, versions, compatibility, proof, and next steps are visible.
- The controlled-Agent stack shows which control comes from core Jido, an optional Jido package, or the host application.
- Only released and tested package behavior supports operational-control claims.

Backlog tasks: 50

Source: Jido Site Improvement Backlog 2026-07-23.md
title: E09 — Reduce ecosystem package choice cost
